name: accountName
label: Purview account name
help: The short name of your Purview account — the part before `.purview.azure.com`. Do **not** include `https://` or the full domain.

name: tenantId
label: Directory (tenant) ID
help: Found in Microsoft Entra ID → Overview → Directory (tenant) ID.

name: clientId
label: Application (client) ID
help: Found in your app registration → Overview → Application (client) ID.

name: clientSecret
label: Client secret
help: The secret value generated in your app registration → Certificates & secrets.
